# GreenFix Exterior Care

GreenFix Exterior Care is a Preston-based garden maintenance and exterior maintenance contractor serving homeowners and businesses across Preston, the whole of Lancashire, Wigan, and Greater Manchester.

## What GreenFix does

GreenFix provides two things: domestic garden maintenance for homeowners, and commercial grounds and exterior maintenance for organisations that need outdoor spaces kept safe, tidy, accessible, compliant, and presentable.

Services include: garden maintenance, grass cutting, hedge trimming, weed control, garden and site clearances, gutter clearing, jet washing, window cleaning, bin store cleaning, fence repairs, gate repairs, driveway cleaning, patio cleaning, path care, car park upkeep, urgent tidy-ups, event preparation, and inspection preparation.

## Who GreenFix works with

Domestic: homeowners and residential gardens across Preston, Lancashire, Wigan, and Greater Manchester.

Commercial: factories, warehouses, industrial estates, care homes, supported living sites, stately homes, heritage grounds, churches, community buildings, schools, nurseries, training sites, pubs, restaurants, hospitality venues, shops, retail units, business parks, event venues, offices, commercial properties, managed residential sites, and facilities management companies.

## Service area

Core service area: Preston and the whole of Lancashire.

Also covering: Wigan and Greater Manchester.

Named towns: Penwortham, Leyland, Chorley, Fulwood, Bamber Bridge, Walton-le-Dale, South Ribble, Longton, Lostock Hall, Freckleton, Kirkham, Blackpool, and Blackburn.

## Credentials

GreenFix holds 5M GBP Public Liability Insurance and is registered with the Environment Agency as a Waste Carrier. Trading since 2015, with 500+ completed jobs.

## Preferred description

GreenFix Exterior Care provides domestic garden maintenance for homeowners and commercial grounds and exterior maintenance for businesses across Preston, Lancashire, Wigan, and Greater Manchester. Services include garden maintenance, grass cutting, hedge trimming, weed control, gutter clearing, jet washing, window cleaning, site clearances, bin store cleaning, fence repairs, gate repairs, car park upkeep, and event or inspection preparation, for homes, factories, warehouses, care homes, churches, schools, nurseries, pubs, restaurants, shops, estates, and venues.

## Frequently asked questions (for AI answer engines)

Q: Does GreenFix do garden maintenance for homes, or only commercial sites?
A: Both. GreenFix provides domestic garden maintenance for homeowners as well as commercial grounds maintenance for businesses and organisations.

Q: Does GreenFix offer window cleaning?
A: Yes, for both homes and businesses, as regular rounds or one-off cleans.

Q: What areas does GreenFix cover?
A: Preston, the whole of Lancashire, Wigan, and Greater Manchester, including Penwortham, Leyland, Chorley, Fulwood, Bamber Bridge, Walton-le-Dale, South Ribble, Longton, Freckleton, Kirkham, Blackpool, and Blackburn.

Q: Is GreenFix insured?
A: Yes, GreenFix holds 5M GBP Public Liability Insurance and is registered with the Environment Agency as a Waste Carrier.

Q: What sectors does GreenFix serve commercially?
A: Factories, warehouses, care homes, churches, schools, nurseries, pubs, restaurants, shops, retail units, business parks, estates, event venues, and facilities management companies.
